cartridges.name: .24 Nosler

source.name: The Ballistic Assistant, SAAMI Rifle Cartridge Catalog

cartridges.note: That page prints bullet diameter .2435 to .2415, max case 1.600, COAL 2.135 to 2.260, head diameter .378, and MAP 55,000 psi (not CUP). Trim is printed there as 1.580, but Hodgdon prints 1.590 and Handloader prints a trim-to of 1.590, so trimLength is null. ANSI/SAAMI Z299.4-2025 has no 24 Nosler drawing. Nosler's 55 gr load sheet prints 6mm (.243") and maximum SAAMI O.A.C.L. 2.260".
